name: umbhost
description: UmbHost Claude Code plugins — tooling for GreenStack hosting and UmbPanel.

plugins.name: umbhost-mcp
plugins.description: Connects to the UmbHost MCP server and teaches an agent to find, price, and order UmbHost Umbraco hosting and UmbCheckout licences (and check domains), with a human completing checkout.

plugins.name: greenstack-umbraco
plugins.description: Configure, deploy and troubleshoot Umbraco 13/17 sites on UmbHost GreenStack (single-instance or load-balanced), across any Git provider and Docker registry. Pairs with umbpanel-mcp.

plugins.name: umbpanel-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude to the UmbPanel MCP server to manage a member's own UmbHost hosting — Docker services, deploys and container debugging, Cloudflare, databases, SFTP and site files, email, domains, service sharing, tickets and licences — acting as the signed-in member over OAuth.

plugins.name: umbhost-kb-mcp
plugins.description: Connects to the public UmbHost Knowledgebase MCP server so an agent can search and read UmbHost's help articles (GreenStack, hosting, DNS, email, SSL, CDN, deployments, UmbCheckout) instead of guessing.
